correctness.rationale: The relation \(x^N=0\) imposes the coefficient restriction; in characteristic two, \(D_f^2=D_{ff\prime}\), so the locus is exactly \(EO=O^2=0\). The parity shift is a rank-preserving injection on each column space. Valuation counting yields the polynomial and total exactly; geometric tails and uniform valuation strata give weak convergence. Independent bounded field-arithmetic checks through length nine over \(\mathbb F_2\) and length six over \(\mathbb F_4\) passed.

value.rationale: The entire rank distribution of the restricted \(2\)-nilpotent locus, and hence its chain-complex homology spectrum, is a natural invariant for the derivation Lie algebra of truncated local rings. The paired-length correspondence and nondegenerate, \(q\)-independent uniform limiting law reveal structural phenomena not obtainable from finite enumeration or the standard restriction-map identity alone.
